description: This file contains a selector function 'canAccessChannelSettings' that determines if a user has access to any tab in the channel settings modal within the Mattermost application. It checks permissions for various channel types and settings based on the application's state.

methods.name: canAccessChannelSettings
methods.description: A selector function that evaluates user permissions for accessing different tabs in the channel settings modal based on channel type, permissions, and configuration flags.
